subject.title: build(deps): bump the actions group across 1 directory with 14 updates

question: Should the repository approve these final SHA-pinned action revisions for workflows that execute with GitHub App private keys, registry credentials, and OpenAI API keys?
rationale: This is a trust-boundary decision about newly executed third-party code and credential exposure; a mechanical dependency update cannot establish the repository’s acceptable supplier and release-review policy.

options.title: Approve reviewed revisions
options.body: A workflow-security owner reviews the final action releases and explicitly accepts the updated pins for the credential-bearing workflows.

options.title: Split or defer sensitive pins
options.body: Keep the routine non-credential workflow updates separate and defer any action revision whose privileged contract has not been reviewed.

recommendation.title: Approve reviewed revisions
recommendation.body: A workflow-security owner reviews the final action releases and explicitly accepts the updated pins for the credential-bearing workflows.

likelyOwner.reason: A human owner must make the external-code trust decision for workflows that receive secrets or privileged tokens.
